overall: Resolved by informal action: the Board violated the Open Meeting Law by entering executive session on August 13 without stating its purpose, but no outside deliberation was found; the Board was ordered to comply going forward.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged that four members, a quorum, met behind closed doors before the August 13 meeting and deliberated outside a posted meeting.
allegations.key_passage: As there is no evidence that members of the Board deliberated outside of a meeting, we find no violation on this point.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Board entered executive session at its August 13 meeting without stating the purpose for doing so.
allegations.key_passage: The Board acknowledges, and we find, that the Board violated the Open Meeting Law when it entered executive session on August 13 without stating the purpose of same.

remedy: Immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law
remedy_passage: We order the Board’s immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law.
